description: This file defines the TaskRepository class, which provides CRUD operations for Task objects backed by a LocalDataStore. It implements methods to retrieve, add, update, delete, and toggle completion status of tasks.

classes.name: TaskRepository
classes.description: Repository class handling CRUD operations for Task objects, interacting with LocalDataStore.

methods.name: getTasks
methods.description: Retrieves the list of tasks from local storage.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Adds a new task to the list and saves it.

methods.name: updateTask
methods.description: Updates an existing task identified by ID and saves the updated list.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Deletes a task by ID from the list and saves the updated list.

methods.name: toggleComplete
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a task by ID.
